product_metadata.title: Barnyard Designs Eat Wood Wall Art Sign, Rustic Primitive Farmhouse Country Kitchen and Home Wall Decor, White/Black, 17" x 7”
features: Eat sign - Welcome people into your kitchen or dining space with this wood wall sign. A cute reminder to eat and be merry. Kitchen decor that makes a beautiful adornment.
Rustic farmhouse country decor - This wall art sign is the perfect piece to complement the country kitchen theme you have in mind with it’s white distressed finish and natural rope details.
Ready to hang - Ready with a hanging rope string that makes this wall decoration so easy to mount. A shabby chic home decor item for a primitive style.
Kitchen wall decor - Ideal decoration for any kitchen or dining room. Use it at your next family gathering, it will definitely add a cheerful look.
Dimensions - This rustic wooden wall sign measures 17" x 7" x 0.75”.
